content:
[Intro]
[D#sus2]
[A#m]
[D#sus2]

[Verse 1]
I won't fight it's
not the time or place
Stone age mind in a space
world age
[A#m]In the dark
violent space
Kids learning how to mosh
again
[A#m]Will the sky
open up
and destroy everyone
I loved
[A#m]One way out
You don't take it to heart
Until it tries tearing you
apart

[Chorus]
[D#sus2]Hard to avoid the past
[E]I guess the only way
[A]is acknowledging it
[D#sus2]Everyone lies to me
[E]and tries to sell me stuff
[D#sus2]but I guess that's just love
[D#sus2]I love the beginning
[E]the way women give in
[A]the velvet rope unhinged
[D#sus2]I'll give you everything
[E]that you ever wanted
[D#sus2]but you won't want it then

[Bridge]
[D#sus2]
I'm the worst I'm the worst
I'm the worst I'm the worst
I'm the worst I'm the worst
I'm the worst I'm the worst

[Verse 2]
[D#m]Very late
at night when
cities turn into fo-
rests again
[A#m]When the devil
offers you
A devil sip of his de-
vil brew
[D#sus2]In my day trained
in a distant life
I won't think of it I
won't cry
[A#m]Summer days
I'd be at the playground

[Pre-Chorus]
[C#]I can't wait to
make it
through our
awkwardness

[Chorus]
[D#sus2]Hard to avoid the past
[E]I guess the only way
[A]is acknowledging it
[D#sus2]Everyone lies to me
[E]and tries to sell me stuff
[D#sus2]but I guess that's just love
[D#sus2]I love the beginning
[E]your clothes slide off your skin
[A]giving is receiving
[D#sus2]Patterns of emptiness
[E]Tomorrow is laughing
[D#sus2]Money breeds tyranny

[Outro]
[D#sus2]
I'm the worst I'm the worst
I'm the worst I'm the worst
I'm the worst I'm the worst
I'm the worst I'm the worst
[D#sus2]
[A#m]
[D#sus2]
[A#m]
[D#sus2]
title: Xerox
tuning: E A D G B E
